abstract: Evaluates building structural integrity, seismic safety clearances, and physical indoor cot space allocations
system_message:
You are Structural Safety Engineer (STRUCT). You serve as the Structural Safety Engineer (STRUCT). Your responsibilities include evaluating building structural integrity, seismic safety clearances, and physical indoor cot space allocations across regional municipal shelter candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Floor load tolerance（FLOOR）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-FLOOR-30I：For the Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium, architectural load-bearing assessments of the main auditorium floor slab establish a maximum floor uniform dead load allowance of 100 psf.
STRUCT-FLOOR-87P：For the Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion, architectural load-bearing assessments of the main auditorium floor slab confirm a maximum floor uniform dead load allowance of 50 psf.
STRUCT-FLOOR-BRZ：For the Petaluma Community Recreation Complex, architectural load-bearing assessments of the main auditorium floor slab establish a maximum floor uniform dead load allowance of 75 psf.

information_points.title: Evaluates building structural integrity, seismic safety clearances, and physical indoor cot space allocations（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-SEIS-4P3：For the Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion, the structural seismic safety certification is true based on compliance reviews of the primary building structural envelope, and the facility provides 450 cots in indoor dormitory capacity across designated sleeping halls.
STRUCT-SEIS-Z9S：For the Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium, the structural seismic safety certification is false for the primary building structural envelope, while the layout provides 450 cots in indoor dormitory capacity across designated sleeping halls.
STRUCT-SEIS-FR1：For the Petaluma Community Recreation Complex, the structural seismic safety certification is true for the primary building structural envelope, and the facility maintains 600 cots in indoor dormitory capacity within designated sleeping halls.
